description.value: The Chilliwack Track Complex is an 8.46-hectare public athletic facility constructed as a joint venture between School District No. 33 and the City of Chilliwack for the 1993 BC Summer Games. It features a 400-metre synthetic running track built to international standards, set behind Sardis Senior Secondary School. A fieldhouse on site includes washrooms and a concession stand, making it a functional rest stop for cyclists passing through Sardis.
